overview: Rainbow AI is a WhatsApp AI assistant for Pelangi Capsule Hostel & Southern Homestay. It handles guest inquiries, booking workflows, and multi-turn conversations via Baileys WebSocket. The focus is on reliability, response quality, and intent classification accuracy.
goals: Improve intent classification accuracy for booking and inquiry intents
Enhance conversation context handling for multi-turn dialogues
Add better fallback responses when AI confidence is low
Improve the booking workflow steps in workflows.json
Prioritize reliability and response quality over new features
Enforce strict business profile separation — each profile's data files must only contain content specific to that business, with zero contamination from other profiles
Fix data-makan and data-southern profiles which currently contain copy-pasted Pelangi Capsule Hostel content
